description: generates placeholder sentences, titles, paragraphs or lists.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Number or inclusive range of paragraphs or list entries; ignored for title and sentence.

attributes.name: seed
attributes.description: Integer seed for repeatable output; empty generates fresh random text.

attributes.name: sentences-per-paragraph
attributes.description: Number or inclusive range of sentences per paragraph; applies only to p.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Generated structure; title and sentence produce plain text.

attributes.name: words-per-sentence
attributes.description: Number or inclusive range of words per sentence or title.

methods.name: regenerate(): void
methods.description: Generates new content; the same seed and parameters always reproduce the same output.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-lorem-ipsum>` element implements the Lorem ipsum functionality: generates placeholder sentences, titles, paragraphs or lists.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Generated text | Read, select or copy the placeholder text. There are no component-specific buttons or gestures. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Generated text | No component-specific keyboard shortcut or extra focus stop. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
